title: Remove dead speciation code from cell.py divide method
details: The speciation block in cell.py divide() references self.field and self._world which are never set. This code is dead and broken. Remove it to eliminate confusion and potential FutureErrors.
notes: No source changes needed — dead speciation block was already removed in commit 18fef01 (2026-08-02). Verified cell.py divide() (lines 942-996) contains no references to self.field/self._world; refresh_class() in __init__ (line 159) correctly handles child cls/color. Syntax and import checks pass.
